snippet.title: [LIMIT ZERO BREAKERS] Prologue Test Trailer | Begins June 10
snippet.description:
The LIMIT ZERO BREAKERS Prologue Test begins June 10.
Be among the first to experience fast-paced action combat, unique playable characters, and intense boss battles.

■ Sign-Ups Close:
June 2 PDT

■ Prologue Test Period
June 10 – June 15 PDT
